Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
baa...@cs.utwente.nl (Phi) writes:

>I believe Sabine is the one who can transfer her blood to other
>Tremere in the game, can she also do that on uncontrolled Tremere?
>Just wondering...

No. By default, nothing affects uncontrolled vampires.
To affect an uncontrolled vampire, the effect must state such
explicitly.
